answer: A reef job over ten units needs more than a pitch: the agent applies with three sonnets, signed verses from three past clients, and locks one onyx, a five-unit deposit, behind the bid. Any trader may challenge a reference within 48 hours; the client must confirm. A forged sonnet, a silent client, or one onyx behind two bids forfeits the deposit and bars the agent. Honest agents reclaim it; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 deposits, 5,000 units.
